invariants.effect: CreatureCmd.SetMaxHp(osty, amount), then CreatureCmd.Heal(osty, amount, isReviving)

summary: Summoning while Osty is alive adds to that creature's max HP. Summoning while Osty is dead or absent sets the revived/new creature's max HP to the summon amount and heals it by that amount; previous in-combat max-HP growth is therefore not retained.
title: Osty summon, growth, death, and revival
